page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. With a 1:1 mapping of physical cores to vCPUs and no hyperthreading enabled, this instance provides predictable, dedicated compute resources without resource sharing at the thread level.

The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage operations must be handled via attached network volumes. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, facilitating data transfer between the instance and external storage or other network resources.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.c6t.13xlarge is its low memory-to-CPU ratio and the complete absence of local storage, which limits its suitability for memory-intensive databases or high-speed local caching workloads. However, the dedicated, non-hyperthreaded CPU allocation makes it highly efficient for compute-bound tasks. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, and CPU-heavy web serving or application hosting where predictable execution times are critical.
